title: US Business Activity Expands at Fastest Pace Since 2022
summary: S&P Global Flash Composite PMI jumped to 56.0 in August, up from 54.5 in July and the highest reading since April 2022, driven primarily by a services sector surge. S&P Global said survey data point to US economic growth approaching a 3% annualized rate in Q3.
why: 美国经济加速信号明显强于预期，推升市场对企业盈利的乐观预期；同时也加强了美联储9月可能进一步收紧的预期，需关注高利率对估值的压制效应；sell put策略在VIX较低时需提高行权价审慎度。

title: Gold Rallies to 3-Month High Near $4,600 as Dollar Weakens, Treasury Buyback Revives Debasement Fears
summary: Spot gold climbed to $4,601-$4,604/oz on August 21-22, its highest since May 15, on track for a third consecutive weekly gain (~5%). The driver: US Treasury's doubling of bond buyback cap to $4B+ per operation stoked fiscal-debasement concerns, while the DXY hit a 3-month low.
why: 金价创3个月新高，直接利好老铺黄金（6181.HK）高端黄金首饰需求预期；同时金价强势反映避险情绪未消，尽管美股同日回升，仍需关注二者分叉信号。

title: US Stocks Rise on Aug. 22: S&P 500 +0.43%, Dow +0.98%, Tesla Leads Gains After Volatile Yield-Driven Week
summary: S&P 500 closed at 7,674.37 (+0.43%), Dow at 53,277.01 (+0.98%), Nasdaq at 26,180.46 (+0.43%) on August 22. Tesla surged 5.14% to lead gains. VIX fell 5.5%, 10-year yield retreated, and DXY dropped 0.70%. Markets on track for first weekly decline since late July despite Friday's bounce.
why: 本周整体为美股四周来首次单周下跌，尽管周五反弹——上周美债收益率飙升引发的抛售仍未完全消化；Tesla个股因Cybercab进展领涨，反映市场开始重新定价自动驾驶叙事。关注下周Nvidia（8月26日）和PDD（8月24日）财报能否提振市场情绪。

title: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 Earnings Due Aug. 26: $91B Revenue Guided, AI Data Center in Focus
summary: Nvidia will report fiscal Q2 2027 results on Aug. 26 after market close, having guided ~$91B in revenue (vs. analyst consensus $91.85B). Data Center grew 92% to $75B last quarter. Analysts expect EPS of $2.09, nearly double a year ago. The Blackwell platform ramp and forward guidance on hyperscaler demand will be the key variables.
why: 全球最受关注的AI硬件财报，英伟达的指引将直接影响AI资本支出周期判断，对SK海力士、美光等HBM相关标的有联动效应；若指引超预期，将强化AI赛道bull case并可能驱动整体科技股重新估值。本持仓无直接英伟达头寸，但作为美股市场情绪锚具有极高参考价值。

title: 腾讯8月21日回购66.7万股耗资约3亿港元，股价约449-451港元区间
summary: 腾讯控股（00700）8月21日再度在市场回购667,000股，合计耗资约3亿港元。腾讯自5月中旬起几乎每日回购，6月单月回购额逾90亿港元创年度新高，目前股价约450港元区间运行。
why: 腾讯持续高强度回购是股东价值回报的明确信号，有助于托底股价并压缩流通股本；对卖出看跌期权策略而言，回购支撑降低了短期大幅下行风险，期权策略可维持偏进攻性行权价。

title: Futu Holdings Q2 2026: Record Trading Volume Drives Revenue +35.6%, Net Income +41.6%
summary: Futu Holdings (FUTU) reported Q2 2026 results on Aug. 20: total revenues rose 35.6% YoY to HK$7.20B (beat estimate of HK$6.35B); net income +41.6% to HK$3.64B; EPS HK$26.08 vs. estimate HK$24.01. Total trading volume hit record HK$6.42 trillion (+78.8% YoY); client assets rose 43.6% to HK$1.40 trillion. Added 252,000 net new funded accounts (total: 3.84M). Shares rose ~7% in pre-market.
why: 富途（FUTU）强劲Q2印证互联网券商受益于港股/美股交投活跃与新资金入市双重驱动；EPS超预期$4.82（+23%）显示盈利弹性仍强，对持仓期权策略参考意义：富途的盈利能力提升有助于其估值修复，可关注卖PUT机会。

title: Tesla Stock Surges 5%+ Weekly on Cybercab Momentum: Austin Hub Permit Filed, Sept. 3 Launch Event Set
summary: TSLA closed at ~$362.86 on Aug. 22 (+5.2% on the week). Catalyst: permit filings for a dedicated Cybercab charging hub in Austin, TX — Phase 1 (48 V3 Superchargers) + Phase 2 (80 wireless chargers) across 128 parking spaces. Tesla employee test rides for the Cybercab are expected to begin before month-end; qualifying event runs through Aug. 23. Full launch event set for Sept. 3.
why: Cybercab从期权叙事变为物理部署——充电枢纽施工许可是可证伪的进度节点，让Robotaxi商业化时间轴预期前移；对TSLA sell put策略：股价重回$350+区间，隐含波动率可能仍偏高，若9月3日发布会顺利进行则可考虑卖出更高行权价的看跌。

title: PDD Holdings Q2 2026 Results Due Aug. 24: Wall Street Expects EPS $2.77 on $17.1B Revenue as Temu Growth Scrutinized
summary: PDD Holdings will report Q2 2026 earnings before market open on Aug. 24, with a conference call at 7:30 a.m. ET. Consensus: EPS $2.77, revenue ~$17.13B. Stock is down ~40% from its 52-week high. Key watch: Temu international margin trajectory and whether high marketing spend is showing ROI. Analysts split with moderate buy consensus but some downgrade to underperform.
why: 拼多多（PDD）明日财报是本周最重要的中国互联网催化剂之一；Temu出海成本压制利润率是核心争议点；鉴于股价已跌40%，若业绩超预期且管理层给出积极指引，可关注反弹做空波动率机会（卖出看跌）；反之需防范进一步下行风险。
